entries.en: That was a bluff. Can't believe you fell for it. Thought I was gonna spill, just like that?
entries.en_m: That was a bluff. Can't believe you fell for it. Ya thought I was gonna spill, just like that?
entries.ro: A fost un bluff. Nici nu-mi vine să cred că ai căzut în plasă. Credeai că o să cânt, așa, pur și simplu?

entries.en: Uhhh… now in human rather than machine?

entries.en: Go die in a ditch, you lying cunt.

entries.en: Gonna hold out on me now? Really?

entries.en: And don't come back here. Ever.

entries.en: Things got outta hand, I'll admit. But cooperate, and no one else'll get hurt.

entries.en: Just stay on point.

entries.en: I don't negotiate with terrorists.

entries.en: What? Don't tell me you forgot already. We made a deal, you're gonna stick to it.

entries.en: Info's worth grands of eddies.

entries.en: At the same time, it'll keep track of and block any attempts to modify the core on the go.

entries.en: Need SmartEye – latest version.

entries.ro: Îmi trebuie SmartEye – ultima versiune.

entries.en: Go down to reception – they'll find you your soulmate two-point-oh in even fewer seconds than that.

entries.en: What's your price?

entries.en: I look like either of those to you?
entries.ro: Arăt eu ca vreuna din alea?

entries.en: An' I'll be sure to let your bosses know how you treat your customers.
entries.ro: Și o să mă asigur că șefii tăi află cum îți tratezi clienții.

entries.en: Casting 'em out on the street ain't an option, either – can't risk tanking our cred.

entries.en: Prolly not.

entries.en: "On your way out" – was that somehow unclear to you?

entries.en: I said, I'm busy.
entries.ro: Am zis că sunt ocupat.

entries.en: Too bad you can't talk to dead people. Oh wait, you're doing it now. Anyway, just scour his comp.

entries.en: That just might work.
entries.ro: Ar putea funcționa.

entries.en: You sit here on this dank hole you probably call your "office" and think you've got it made, don't ya?

entries.en: Tyger Claw bosses've got their own bosses, case you didn't know. You're just too small to see 'em.

entries.ro: Șefii Tyger Claws au și ei șefi, în caz că nu știai. Ești prea jos pe lanț ca să-i vezi.

entries.en: Congrats, you read minds better than our own fucking AI. Someone get this girl a job.

entries.en: Oh, 'cause you're such a big shot?

entries.en: By who? A client?

entries.en: No, outside job, some kinda crackshot netrunner. Punched through our ICE like it was cheap wallpaper.
